original_config.objective: One direct hardness squared-error loss per original image
original_config.skip: Fixed training-only Ridge on raw object means/stds and globals
original_config.architecture: Context-conditioned phi, area-weighted mean/std, small head
original_config.normalization: Fit within each training subset; equal total object weight per image
original_config.selection: One inner image split selects epoch, then all outer-training images refit
original_config.epoch_zero: Ridge skip is eligible if learned correction does not improve inner loss

aggregation: Equal mean of all three, regardless of individual validation scores
stage: Predetermined seed confirmation after original single-seed result
